exposure: prior successful vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC)
Prior successful vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC)
Women attempting first vaginal delivery after cesarean
cohort: 3256 women attempting labor after cesarean delivery
finding: In women attempting labor after cesarean, prior VBAC is associated with a lower rate of uterine rupture and a higher rate of successful vaginal birth.
mod_finding: Women with a prior successful vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) had a significantly lower rate of uterine rupture and a higher rate of successful vaginal birth compared to those undergoing their first VBAC.
